description: Everything the public catalog holds on one card: issuer, annual fee, network, foreign transaction fee, rewards currency, and the names of its statement credits, lounge networks and protections. Card name is matched loosely. Card facts only — no earning rates, welcome-offer amounts, transfer ratios, or bonus sizes.
